items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Solo / Quartet was originally John Koenig

ctx.x: Bobby recorded for Landmark maybe once?
Yeah, because Solo / Quartet was originally John Koenig, which was – what label was that? I can’t think.
We can pick it up tomorrow. We’re going to have to cut it short. But I know you started doing a lot of sideman work with Fantasy, work with McCoy and . . .
